text:
Jonah: kicking off rollout now — rolling service-api 4.2.1 -> 4.3.0 to 10% in eu-west, tagging @Sara @Kevin for stop/go
ReleaseBot: deploybot: rollout rl-7832 started; cohort=10%; region=eu-west; target=service-api:4.3.0
```
deploy id=rl-7832
cohort=10%
started_by=jonah
workers=4
status=warming
```
Sara: quick heads up — seeing a +0.8% spike in 503s on the cohort, tail latency creeping. grabbing traces :eyes:
Kevin: looking at perf dashboard https://internal.redwood/dash/rl-7832 — 95p latency +220ms vs baseline
Maria P.: any changes to quant/profile on 4.3.0? we pinned quant profile on previous rollouts, wondering if model variant changed
ops-oncall: logs look like kvcache thrash on a subset of pods, some decoder shards OOMing. suggestion: pause ramp and reduce to 5% while we inspect, or move those hosts back to 4.2.1
Jonah: hold or rollback? we still have the rest of the fleet on 4.2.1
ReleaseBot: executing: `redwoodctl rollout pause rl-7832 --reason "observed-503s"`
```
rollout rl-7832 status => paused at 10%
affected_hosts: 4
notes: ramp paused per request
```
Sara: vote=hold. we should not push to 30% while shard oom appears :thumbsup:
Kevin: +1 hold. recommend pinning traffic and scheduling a limited rollback for the problematic nodes. I'll run the rollback runbook steps and notify infra
Maria P.: if we pin, also mark the quant+kernel selection for infra review; might be a kernel mismatch on new runtime path
Jonah: ok executing pin and rollback commands now
ReleaseBot: `redwoodctl rollout hold rl-7832 --pin-version 4.2.1 --annotate "kvcache-oom-observed"`
```
rollout rl-7832 => held
traffic pinned to service-api:4.2.1
scheduled rollback: targeted hosts: host-12, host-15
next_steps: infra to inspect decoder memory patterns
```
Tom: product note — change window team, please update status page and EU customers in the 22:00 change window. we'll draft a short note referencing "traffic safety hold"
Sara: capturing traces + flamegraphs, will post summary in <#eng-runtime> and link here when ready
Kevin: filing postmortem stub and set owner to @kevin; stopping further shifts until infra confirms fix
Jonah: thanks — holding here. reopening when infra gives green or we have a patch release (4.3.0-rc1) reviewed."
